product: Workout builder that writes sessions around the equipment your gym actually has

banned_topics: other fitness apps named or shown
rules.tone: Plain, grounded gym talk from a normal lifter describing a planning tool, never coaching or promising results.

guidance.hook_style: Open with the constraint in on-screen text before anyone speaks — name the broken or busy gym, not the app.
angles: My gym is trash and I made it work — pan the gym, show what's missing, show the loadout it built
Travel / hotel gym — two saved gyms, wildly different plans, same tracking
Busy-hour reroute — station taken, app swaps the lift, you keep moving (highest converting)
Beginner walkthrough — 'I didn't know what to do in here' to an ordered session, descriptive not instructional
The switch — the screenshotted programme that assumed a full commercial gym and why it broke
notes: Five to six slides is the sweet spot; three reads as an ad, nine loses people before the payoff
Strongest structure: problem → attempt → app → session → result
Legible app screen means no speed ramp, no heavy filter, no sticker covering the equipment list; 1080x1920 minimum
Single-shot video with no slides: app on screen within the first 5 seconds for a cumulative 4s minimum
Paid partnership toggle on for both platforms and #ad in the first line of the caption
App footage must be the real app on your own phone
Only the free tier and Loadout Plus at £6.99/mo may be referenced
Avoid trending audio that crowds out the app screen and 'day in my life' formats where the product lands at second 40
Account minimum 2,000 followers plus a country-split analytics screenshot at registration
Submit every post in #submissions with platform link, slide count and 96-hour analytics screenshot; unsubmitted posts are not paid
Deleted, archived or caption-edited posts void the claim; payouts weekly on Thursdays, 14-day terms from approval
Ask edge cases in #loadout-brief before filming — pre-approvals are honoured
Live window 3 Feb – 16 Mar, campaign closes when the budget is spent
